mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of months with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 5.0%, it signals a tightening labor market that accelerates corporate hiring and profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of months with UNRATE < 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate signal coordinated monetary and labor market stimulus that amplifies corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary easing with labor market tightening
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >60% of months with declining FEDFUNDS and UNRATE, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Residential sales (RSAFS) exceeding its 3-month moving average indicates housing market strength that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of months with RSAFS above 3-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of months with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1,000,000 units per month, it signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >60% of months with HOUST < 1000, or Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and increase in industrial production signals effective monetary policy response to economic weakness that accelerates recovery, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of months with declining FEDFUNDS and rising INDPRO, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceed 200,000 jobs per month, it indicates strong labor market growth that supports consumer spending and corporate hiring, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of months with PAYEMS > 200, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
